\n17b:T1\n390,\n

Shortcut Trick\n

Total Annual Expenditure = (3 × 1100) + (5 × 1000) + (4 × 1200) = Rs. 13100

\n

Total Annual Income = Total Expenditure + Total Savings = 13100 + 1300 = Rs. 14400

\n

Average Monthly Income = Total Income ÷ 12 = 14400 ÷ 12 = Rs. 1200

\n

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1200.

{"prompt": "4", "value": "3 ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "

Given:

\n\n

Simple interest received = 2/5 of the sum

\n\n

Time period = 40 years

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T) / 100

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let the Principal (P) be 100 units (for simplicity).

\n\n

Simple Interest (SI) = (2/5) × 100 = 40 units

\n\n

Time (T) = 40 years

\n\n

We know SI = P × R × T / 100

\n\n

⇒ 40 = 100 × R × 40 / 100

\n\n

⇒ 40 = 40R

\n\n

⇒ R = 40 / 40

\n\n

⇒ R = 1%

\n\n

The annual rate of interest is 1%.

दिया गया है:

\n\n

प्राप्त साधारण ब्याज = मूलधन का 2/5

\n\n

समयावधि = 40 वर्ष

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

साधारण ब्याज (SI) = मूलधन (P) × दर (R) × समय (T) / 100

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

मान लीजिए मूलधन (P) 100 इकाई है (सरलता के लिए)।

\n\n

साधारण ब्याज (SI) = (2/5) × 100 = 40 इकाई

\n\n

समय (T) = 40 वर्ष

\n\n

हम जानते हैं कि SI = P × R × T / 100

\n\n

⇒ 40 = 100 × R × 40 / 100

\n\n

⇒ 40 = 40R

\n\n

⇒ R = 40 / 40

\n\n

⇒ R = 1%

\n\n

वार्षिक ब्याज दर 1% है।

బారువడ్డి = మొత్తంలో 2/5 వంతు

\n\n

కాల వ్యవధి = 40 సంవత్సరాలు

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

\n\n

బారువడ్డి (SI) = మూలధనం (P) x రేటు (R) x కాలం (T) / 100

\n\n

\n\n

మూలధనం (P) 100 ఒకట్లు అని అనుకుందాం (సరళత కోసం).

\n\n

సాధారణ వడ్డీ (SI) = (2/5) x 100 = 40 ఒకట్లు

\n\n

కాలం (T) = 40 సంవత్సరాలు

\n\n

మనకు తెలుసు SI = P x R x T / 100

\n\n

⇒ 40 = 100 x R x 40 / 100

\n\n

⇒ 40 = 40R

\n\n

⇒ R = 40 / 40

\n\n

⇒ R = 1%

\n\n

వార్షిక వడ్డీ రేటు 1%.

Given:

\n\n

Selling price of A = Rs. 5000

\n\n

Selling price of B = Rs. 5000

\n\n

Profit of A = 25%

\n\n

Loss of B = 10%

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Cost Price (CP) =\n Selling Price (SP) / (1 + Profit%)

\n\n

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price (SP) / (1 - Loss%)

\n\n

Ratio = CP of A / CP of B

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

CP of A = 5000 / (1 + 25/100)

\n\n

⇒ CP of A = 5000 / 1.25

\n\n

⇒ CP of A = 4000

\n\n

CP of B = 5000 / (1 - 10/100)

\n\n

⇒ CP of B = 5000 / 0.9

\n\n

⇒ CP of B = 5555.56

\n\n

Ratio of CP of A to CP of B = 4000 / 5555.56

\n\n

⇒ Ratio = 0.72

\n\n

⇒ Ratio = 18 : 25

\n\n

The ratio of cost prices of A and B is 18 ∶ 25.

दिया गया है:

\n\n

A का विक्रय मूल्य = 5000 रुपये

\n\n

B का विक्रय मूल्य = 5000 रुपये

\n\n

A का लाभ = 25%

\n\n

B की हानि = 10%

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

क्रय मूल्य (CP) = विक्रय मूल्य (SP) / (1 + लाभ%)

\n\n

क्रय मूल्य (CP) = विक्रय मूल्य (SP) / (1 - हानि%)

\n\n

अनुपात = A का CP / B का CP

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

A का क्रय मूल्य = 5000 / (1 + 25/100)

\n\n

⇒ A का क्रय मूल्य = 5000 / 1.25

\n\n

⇒ A का क्रय मूल्य = 4000

\n\n

B का क्रय मूल्य = 5000 / (1 - 10/100)

\n\n

⇒ B का क्रय मूल्य = 5000 / 0.9

\n\n

⇒ B का क्रय मूल्य = 5555.56

\n\n

A के क्रय मूल्य और B के क्रय मूल्य का अनुपात = 4000 / 5555.56

\n\n

⇒ अनुपात = 0.72

\n\n

⇒ अनुपात = 18 : 25

\n\n

A और B के क्रय मूल्य का अनुपात 18 ∶ 25 है।

Given:

\n\n

Length of each train = 320 metres

\n\n

Time taken to cross each other = 18 seconds

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Relative Speed = (Total Distance) / (Time)

\n\n

Speed of each train = (Relative Speed) / 2

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Total Distance = Length of Train 1 + Length of Train 2 = 320 + 320 = 640 metres

\n\n

Relative Speed = 640 / 18

\n\n

Relative Speed = 35.56 m/s

\n\n

Speed of each train = 35.56 / 2

\n\n

Speed of each train = 17.78 m/s

\n\n

To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5

\n\n

Speed of each train = 17.78 × 18/5

\n\n

Speed of each train = 64 km/hr

\n\n

The speed of each train is 64 km/hr.

दिया गया है:

\n\n

प्रत्येक ट्रेन की लंबाई = 320 मीटर

\n\n

एक दूसरे को पार करने में लगा समय = 18 सेकंड

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

सापेक्ष चाल = (कुल दूरी) / (समय)

\n\n

प्रत्येक ट्रेन की चाल = (सापेक्ष चाल) / 2

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

कुल दूरी = ट्रेन 1 की लंबाई + ट्रेन 2 की लंबाई = 320 + 320 = 640 मीटर

\n\n

सापेक्ष चाल = 640 / 18

\n\n

सापेक्ष चाल = 35.56 मीटर/सेकेंड

\n\n

प्रत्येक ट्रेन की चाल = 35.56 / 2

\n\n

प्रत्येक ट्रेन की चाल = 17.78 मीटर/सेकेंड

\n\n

मीटर/सेकंड को किलोमीटर/घंटा में बदलने के लिए 18/5 से गुणा करते हैं।

\n\n

प्रत्येक ट्रेन की चाल = 17.78 x 18/5

\n\n

प्रत्येक ट्रेन की चाल = 64 किमी/घंटा

\n\n

प्रत्येक ट्रेन की अभीष्ट चाल 64 किमी/घंटा है।

প্রদত্ত:

\n\n

প্রতিটি ট্রেনের দৈর্ঘ্য = 320 মিটার

\n\n

একে অপরকে অতিক্রম করতে সময় লাগে = 18 সেকেন্ড

\n\n

অনুসৃত সূত্র:

\n\n

আপেক্ষিক গতিবেগ = (মোট দূরত্ব) / (সময়)

\n\n

প্রতিটি ট্রেনের গতিবেগ = (আপেক্ষিক গতিবেগ) / 2

\n\n

গণনা:

\n\n

মোট দূরত্ব = 1 ఇచ్చినవి:

\n\n

ప్రతి రైలు పొడవు = 320 మీటర్లు

\n\n

ఒకదానికొకటి దాటవేయడానికి పట్టే సమయం = 18 సెకన్లు

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

\n\n

సాపేక్ష వేగం = (మొత్తం దూరం) / (సమయం)

\n\n

ప్రతి రైలు వేగం = (సాపేక్ష వేగం) / 2

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

మొత్తం దూరం = రైలు 1 పొడవు + రైలు 2 పొడవు = 320 + 320 = 640 మీటర్లు

\n\n

సాపేక్ష వేగం = 640 / 18

\n\n

సాపేక్ష వేగం = 35.56 మీ/సె

\n\n

ప్రతి రైలు వేగం = 35.56 / 2

\n\n

ప్రతి రైలు వేగం = 17.78 మీ/సె

\n\n

మీ/సె ను కిమీ/గం గా మార్చడానికి, 18/5 తో గుణించండి

\n\n

ప్రతి రైలు వేగం = 17.78 x 18/5

\n\n

ప్రతి రైలు వేగం = 64 కిమీ/గం 

\n\n

ప్రతి రైలు వేగం 64 కిమీ/గం.

கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

ஒவ்வொரு ரயிலின் நீளம் = 320 மீட்டர்

ஒன்றையொன்று கடக்க எடுக்கும் நேரம் = 18 வினாடிகள்

பயன்படுத்திய சூத்திரம்:

தொடர்புடைய வேகம் = (மொத்த தூரம்) / (நேரம்)

ஒவ்வொரு ரயிலின் வேகம் = (உறவினர் வேகம்) / 2

கணக்கீடு:

மொத்த தூரம் = ரயிலின் நீளம் 1 + ரயிலின் நீளம் 2 = 320 + 320 = 640 மீட்டர்

ஒப்பீட்டு வேகம் = 640/18

ஒப்பீட்டு வேகம் = 35.56 மீ/வி

ஒவ்வொரு ரயிலின் வேகம் = 35.56/2

ஒவ்வொரு ரயிலின் வேகம் = 17.78 மீ/வி

m/s ஐ km/hr ஆக மாற்ற, 18/5 ஆல் பெருக்கவும்

ஒவ்வொரு ரயிலின் வேகம் = 17.78 x 18/5

ஒவ்வொரு ரயிலின் வேகம் = 64 km/hr

ஒவ்வொரு ரயிலின் வேகமும் மணிக்கு 64 கி.மீ.

Given:

\n\n

Ages of the 7 men in the cricket team: 26, 25, 21, 29, 24, 28, 22

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Average Age = Sum of all ages / Number of men

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Sum of all ages = 26 + 25 + 21 + 29 + 24 + 28 + 22

\n\n

Sum of all ages = 175

\n\n

Number of men = 7

\n\n

Average Age = 175 / 7

\n\n

⇒ Average Age = 25

\n\n

The average age of the cricket team is 25 years.

Given:

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Ratio = (M + N) ∶ (M - N)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let M = 9k and N = 6k

\n\n

M + N = 9k + 6k = 15k

\n\n

M - N = 9k - 6k = 3k

\n\n

Ratio = (M + N) ∶ (M - N)

\n\n

⇒ Ratio = 15k ∶ 3k

\n\n

⇒ Ratio = 15 ∶ 3

\n\n

⇒ Ratio = 5 ∶ 1

\n\n

The value of (M + N) ∶ (M - N) is 5 ∶ 1.

\n\n

Selling price after two discounts = Rs. 1400

\n\n

First discount = 20%

\n\n

Second discount = x%

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - First Discount) × (1 - Second Discount)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let the second discount be x%

\n\n

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - First Discount) × (1 - Second Discount)

\n\n

1400 = 2000 × (1 - 0.20) × (1 - x/100)

\n\n

1400 = 2000 × 0.80 × (1 - x/100)

\n\n

1400 = 1600 × (1 - x/100)

\n\n

⇒ 1400 / 1600 = 1 - x/100

\n\n

⇒ 0.875 = 1 - x/100

\n\n

⇒ x/100 = 1 - 0.875

\n\n

⇒ x/100 = 0.125

\n\n

⇒ x = 0.125 × 100

\n\n

⇒ x = 12.5

\n\n

The value of x is 12.5 percent.

      \n\t\t
    • Example: The choir's voices blended in perfect harmony.
      • \n\t
    \n\t
    • \n\t

\n\n

\n\n
    \n\t

      \n\t\t
    • For example: The president was greeted with a huge round of applause.

    \n\t
    • \n\t

    • \n\t

    • \n\t

\n\n

Therefore, the correct answer is 'with'.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n\n
    \n\t

    • Example: "The protest was against the new law."
      • \n\t
    \n\t
    • \n\t
  • To: This preposition is often used to indicate direction or destination.\n\t

    • Example: "She went to the market."

    • \n\t

      \n\t\t
    • Example: "He went there for a meeting."
      • \n\t
    \n\t
    • \n

\n\n

\n\n
    \n\t
  • The verb tense 'meet' is incorrect for this past event.
    • \n\t
  • 'met' is required for past tense agreement.

  • The article 'an' is incorrect before 'homeless'.
    • \n\t
  • 'a' should be used because 'homeless' starts with a consonant sound.
    • \n\t
  • The sentence describes an event that has already happened; hence, past tense 'met' is appropriate.
    • \n
\n\n

The corrected sentence should be: "I met a homeless person in New York."

\n\n

Additional Information

\n\n
    \n\t
  • Met an homeless: Incorrect due to the misuse of the article 'an' before a word beginning with a consonant sound.
    • \n\t
  • Will met a homeless: Incorrect use of future tense auxiliary 'will' with the past form 'met'; it should be 'will meet' for future tense but this does not fit the context of a past event.
    • \n\t
  • No improvement: Incorrect, as the original sentence contains errors in verb tense and article usage.
    • \n

The correct answer is: 'taller'.

\n\n

Key Points

\n\n
    \n\t
  • The phrase 'not ___ than' indicates a comparative form is needed.
    • \n\t
  • The comparative form of an adjective is used to compare two nouns and typically ends in "-er" or uses the word "more" before the adjective, depending on the word length and spelling rules.
    • \n\t
  • The comparative form of 'tall' is 'taller'.
    • \n\t
  • The context tells us that Mamta and Mansa are comparable in height.
    • \n
\n\n

Therefore, the correct answer is 'taller'.

\n\n

Hence, the corrected sentence is: Mansa is not taller than Mamta.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n\n
    \n\t
  • Tallest: This is a superlative adjective used when comparing more than two entities. It does not fit in a comparative context.
    • \n\t
  • Tall: This is the positive form of the adjective and does not indicate a comparison.
    • \n\t
  • More taller: This is an incorrect comparative form because 'taller' itself is a comparative. Adding 'more' is redundant and grammatically incorrect.
    • \n

\nAdditional Information

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • निश्चल, स्थिर का पर्यायवाची शब्द है।

    • 'निश्चल' के अन्य पर्यायवाची शब्द- अचल, निष्क्रिय, अविचल, अटल, अपरिवर्तनशील आदि ।
      • \n\t
    • पर्यायवाची की परिभाषा:- पर्यायवाची शब्द वे शब्द होते हैं जो भिन्न-भिन्न होते हैं, परंतु उनका अर्थ एक समान होता है।
      • \n\t
    • ये शब्द समान धारणा, भावना, वस्तु, या प्रक्रिया को व्यक्त करते हैं, लेकिन उनके शब्दरूप में विविधता हो सकती है।
      • \n\t
    • पर्यायवाची शब्दों का प्रयोग हमारी भाषा को और अधिक समृद्ध और विविधतापूर्ण बनाता है।
      • \n\t
